summary: Crawford Accountants is a Kew, Melbourne firm established in 1986 with approximately 3,500 clients, led by CPA partners Inzi Pethiyagoda and Heath Neville. It is a Xero Gold Champion partner offering bookkeeping and Virtual CFO services.

sources.title: Receptionist / junior administration assistant - Crawford Accountants

claims.text: Crawford Accountants is a Melbourne accounting firm at Level 1, 86-88 Charles Street, Kew, trading since 1986.
claims.quote: Crawford Accountants are a Melbourne based professional accounting firm working closely with clients in all industries across Australia and abroad.

claims.text: Inzi Pethiyagoda is a CPA Partner at Crawford Accountants and a Certified Xero Advisor.
Inzi has over 15 years of experience advising privately owned businesses on tax, operations, management and growth.
claims.quote: With over 15 years of experience, he has specialist skills in advising privately owned and operated businesses

claims.text: Crawford says it is a Gold Champion partner of Xero and all professional staff are certified Xero advisors.
claims.quote: Crawford Accountants are Gold Champion partners of Xero while all our professional staff are certified Xero advisors.

claims.text: Crawford's bookkeeping service handles day-to-day reconciliations, debtors and creditors, and payroll.
claims.quote: We handle the day-to-day reconciliations, managements of debtors and creditors and your payroll.

claims.text: Crawford has approximately 3,500 clients, including small to medium businesses, partnerships, trusts, super funds and overseas clients.
claims.quote: We have approximately 3,500 clients, including small to medium businesses, partnerships, trusts, superannuation funds

claims.text: Crawford says cloud accounting is its preference and it takes a special interest in modern technology.
claims.quote: We take a special interest in modern technology and hence Cloud Accounting is our preference

claims.text: Crawford posts a monthly client update on LinkedIn; the November 2026 edition covers early release of super schemes and rental property deduction errors.
claims.quote: Our November update is here! Read more about early release of Super Schemes, common rental property deduction errors, private use of work vehicles & more.

claims.text: Crawford advertised a receptionist / junior administration assistant role in September 2026 (applications later paused).
claims.quote: An exciting opportunity has opened up at our firm located in Kew for a friendly Receptionist / Administration Assistant.

claims.text: Crawford's services include tax, business advisory, SMSF, company secretarial, bookkeeping and Virtual CFO Services.

hooks.text: Gold Champion Xero partner whose bookkeeping line handles day-to-day reconciliations across ~3,500 clients
Regular monthly client update on LinkedIn shows a firm that publishes; Virtual CFO line adds management reporting load

risks.text: LinkedIn lists only 5 employees, so the team is small; limited reconciliation volume may not justify a tool

gaps: No bookkeeper job ad found; only a reception role

followUp.subject: Re: Idea for Crawford Accountants
followUp.body:
Hi Inzi,

Following up on my note last week. Crawford is a Xero Gold Champion partner and the bookkeeping page says you handle day-to-day reconciliations for clients. Vert takes reconciliation from hours to minutes with a traceable audit trail, so certified Xero advisors spend that time on advice. How much of the team's week goes on reconciling across your roughly 3,500 clients?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp2.body:
Hi Inzi,

Last note from me. Your monthly update on LinkedIn shows how much you do for clients beyond the books. If reconciling is a bottleneck for the Virtual CFO work, ten minutes to see Vert could be worthwhile.
